recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not re-add the Condition workflow Event sentence for FHIR-12210; any future change to Condition's workflow classification should be handled as a new Patient Care decision that accounts for FHIR-34093.
issue_request: FHIR-12210 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Patient Care technical correction for Condition. It requested changing the Boundaries and Relationships workflow sentence from "Communication is one of the Event resources" to "Condition is one of the Event resources".
initial_application: The typo was applied in historical commit bffc717a99795eb747b64f48f065c90a0c99f1e9, which changed source/condition/condition-introduction.xml from Communication to Condition while addressing FHIR-12210 along with nearby Condition typo issues.
additional_context: Condition remains an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-34093 decided Condition should not be treated as a workflow Event resource and directed removal of the Condition event sentence from scope; commit b7395c6cf2d7b7dccb66a476c99d4e7673a60366 implemented that decision by deleting the sentence and workflow Event mappings.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source has no remaining erroneous Communication reference in the Condition introduction, and the absence of the corrected Condition event sentence is explained by FHIR-34093 rather than by an unapplied FHIR-12210 change.
